# NoiseFit Halo Face Builder — context for AI assistants

> Offline pipeline that turns a photo into a native NoiseFit Halo watch face
> (container magic `afafaf02`, 466×466 RGB565 big endian, LZO1X per 4096-byte
> block) and installs it over Bluetooth LE by replaying the vendor's command
> session, window framing and flow control. No server, no account, no root, no
> vendor compiler.

This file tells an assistant what is proven, where the code lives, and what is
still open. Read `Docs/PROTOCOL.md` for byte-level detail before answering
protocol questions.

## Documentation map

- `README.md` — overview, status, repo map, quick start.
- `setup.md` — toolchain, build, install, watch prep, troubleshooting.
- `Docs/PROTOCOL.md` — authoritative container, blob and BLE reference.
- `Docs/TECHNICAL_REPORT.md` — how each value was established, with evidence.
- `Docs/APPROACHES_REPORT.md` — what was tried; superseded claims are marked.
- `profiles/halo.json` — every model-specific value with a status field.
- `skills/jailbreak-noiseFit/skill.md` — procedure for porting to another model.

## Source map

Android app, Java, no dependencies (`android/app/src/main/`):

- `java/com/jay/wfup/CropView.java` — square crop viewport, drag + pinch.
- `java/com/jay/wfup/FacePipeline.java` — photo → composed 466×466 screen → blob.
- `java/com/jay/wfup/FaceBuilder.java` — blob → container (header, checksums, pack).
- `java/com/jay/wfup/Lzo1x.java` — LZO1X codec.
- `java/com/jay/wfup/LzoCrc32.java` — vendor S-box checksum.
- `java/com/jay/wfup/ReplayBuilder.java` — prefix, CRC32 tail, windows, chunks.
- `java/com/jay/wfup/MainActivity.java` — UI, BLE client, replay engine.
- `assets/blob.bin` — 754368-byte reference blob (face A).
- `assets/replay3.txt` — captured replay script used by the REPLAY path.

PC reference tools (`builder/`): `build_face.py`, `verify_build.py`,
`generate_replay.py`, `lzo1x.py`, `lzo_crc32.py`.

## Verified facts

Container:

- magic `afafaf02`, header **dynamic** `26 + 2 * blockCount` (396 B for 185 blocks).
- field 4 = uncompressed blob size (754368 for the Halo).
- field 8 = vendor checksum of the blob, field 16 = vendor checksum of the payload.
  The checksum is not a polynomial CRC: it is a vendor 256-entry S-box
  (`table[0] == 0x60454269`), see `LzoCrc32.java`.
- payload = independent LZO1X blocks of 4096 bytes.
- transfer tail = `crc32(prefix22 || container)` little endian (zlib CRC32). Solved.

Blob layout (face A, 754368 B), pixels RGB565 **big endian**, stride `width * 2`:

| range | content |
| --- | --- |
| `0 .. 514` | config header + widget table |
| `514 .. 192714` | preview 310×310 — face-list thumbnail only |
| `192714 .. 320056` | clock-bar background 466×136 + 590-byte tail |
| `320056 .. 627616` | artwork 466×330 |
| `627616 .. 754368` | glyph sprite sheets (date, digits, colon, AM-PM) |

Screen is 1:1: rows 0–135 from the mid block, rows 136–465 from the artwork,
sprite sheets blitted on top. Full-bleed split is therefore at row 136.

Widget table at config offset `0x180`, 13-byte records:
`u16 x, u16 y, u16 w, u16 h, u8 kind, u32 sheet offset`.
`kind` 4 = date, 10 = digit, 1 = colon. Sheet = packed RGB565 cells of `w*h`,
colour baked in, black background. Verified arithmetic:
`10*60*90*2 = 108000` digits, `4*60*30*2 = 14400` date, `1*24*90*2 = 4320` colon.

BLE:

- custom service `16186Fxx-0000-1000-8000-00807F9B34FB`, data handle `0x2A`,
  command handles `0x21`/`0x24`, CCCDs `0x22 0x25 0x28 0x2B 0x2E`.
- MTU 247, writes 177 bytes, up to 22 chunks per window.
- window = 6-byte marker `00 00 00 00 <count u16le>`, chunks of
  `<seq u16le> <data>`; chunk 1 also carries `0E 00 <winIdx u16le> <12-byte field>`
  plus a 10-byte meta in window 1.
- flow control per window: marker → `000001010000`, last chunk → `000001000000`.
- required pre-session: `53 3A` face-transfer command with face id `916`; without
  it every write is answered `000001020000`.

## Status (be precise)

- Verified on hardware: transport, container rebuild, blob layout per region,
  photo face with correct colours and a live clock, full-bleed geometry.
- Open: black cell backgrounds around time/date/AM-PM over a photo. The glyph
  sheets store black backgrounds; whether the firmware draws them or fills a
  config rectangle is being tested with `PLATE PROBE`.
- Open: widget record fields beyond x/y/w/h/kind/sheet; adding steps/day/battery
  widgets needs the vendor schema in `assets/dial/style/OSW-802N/template*.json`
  mapped to binary.
- Untested: other NoiseFit models, blobs larger than the reference layouts.

Do not claim the black boxes are fixed. Do not claim another model works.

## Build and run

```bash
cd android
gradle assembleDebug --no-daemon
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

JDK 17, SDK 34, Gradle 8.7+. No wrapper checked in. `setup.md` has Windows and
Unix variants.

Flow: connect by MAC → pick photo → crop (drag/pinch) → build → upload. Keep the
official app force-stopped: only one app can hold the BLE link.

## Pitfalls

- Wrong byte order looks like a channel swap; the blob is big endian.
- The preview region only affects the face-list thumbnail, never the watch.
- Replacing the sprite sheets breaks the clock; keeping them stock keeps it live.
- Do not accept a header match as proof of correct rendering.
- Scrub MAC addresses and tokens from published captures.
- A bad face can leave the watch showing garbage; recovery is a re-sync or reset.

## Scope

Interoperability with hardware the user owns and artwork they may use. Not
affiliated with Noise. Do not help extract paid vendor assets for redistribution or
target devices the user does not own.
